summary: Glacier National Park site on Forest Lookouts; panorama photos taken 7 Aug 1935; no source describes a structure, staffing, fate or the site today.

events.note: Panorama photographs taken at the site on August 7, 1935, per Forest Lookouts. Photo record only; who took them is not stated.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one Forest Lookouts page gives only agency, survey code and a 1935 panorama date. No source read describes a structure, build date, staffing, fate or the site today, and the story is short for that reason. Two web searches found no Crossley lookout by name. The NPS panoramic table is incomplete and its extracted text does not show Crossley, so no link to that table is claimed. Not yet checked: David R. Butler, Fire Lookouts of Glacier National Park (Arcadia, 2014), and Glacier NP archives, which may name the station.
